name: Nextcloud
description: Self-hosted files/cloud collaboration platform, installed from the official release.
install_script:
set -e
SITE="{{ www_root }}/{{ domain }}"
mkdir -p "$SITE"
curl -sSLo /tmp/panelpro-nextcloud.zip https://download.nextcloud.com/server/releases/latest.zip
if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  unzip -q /tmp/panelpro-nextcloud.zip -d /tmp/panelpro-nc
else
  python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/panelpro-nextcloud.zip').extractall('/tmp/panelpro-nc')"
fi
shopt -s dotglob
mv /tmp/panelpro-nc/*/* "$SITE"/
rm -rf /tmp/panelpro-nextcloud.zip /tmp/panelpro-nc
if command -v chown >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  OWNER=$(id -un www-data 2>/dev/null || id -un apache 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$OWNER" ] && chown -R "$OWNER":"$OWNER" "$SITE"
fi
echo "Nextcloud installed at $SITE (DB: {{ db_name }})"
uninstall_script:
rm -rf "{{ www_root }}/{{ domain }}"
echo "Nextcloud folder removed"
